units.meaning: The determination of whether an employee satisfies the hours of service requirement and has been employed by the employer for a total of at least 12 months must be evaluated as of the date the FMLA leave is scheduled to begin.

source_spans.quote: The determination of whether an employee meets the hours of service requirement and has been employed by the employer for a total of at least 12 months must be made as of the date the FMLA leave is to start.

units.meaning: An employee is permitted to be on non-FMLA leave at the point in time when he or she reaches and satisfies the 12-month employment eligibility requirement.

source_spans.quote: An employee may be on non-FMLA leave at the time he or she meets the 12-month eligibility requirement

units.meaning: If an employee is on non-FMLA leave when reaching the 12-month eligibility requirement, any part of the leave taken for an FMLA-qualifying reason subsequent to meeting that requirement qualifies and is treated as FMLA leave.

source_spans.quote: in that event, any portion of the leave taken for an FMLA-qualifying reason after the employee meets the eligibility requirement would be FMLA leave.
An employee may be on non-FMLA leave at the time he or she meets the 12-month eligibility requirement

units.meaning: Provides a cross-reference directing readers to § 825.300(b) for rules governing the content of eligibility notices given to employees, without stating an independent substantive rule in this provision.

source_spans.quote: See § 825.300(b) for rules governing the content of the eligibility notice given to employees.
